title: Separate Review and QA request contracts
description: Exercise isolated production gateways with deterministic read-only GitHub CLI fixtures. Proves configuration, queue migration, historical intake preservation and QA authorization; excludes worker execution and runtime QA.

farm-profiles.intent: Each farm exposes its own thin skill preset and inputs through the project API.

legacy-live-request.intent: A legacy full-live request becomes distinct QA work, retains placement and provenance, and selects the canonical template unchanged.

conflicting-requests.intent: Ambiguous review settings and another farm's QA preset create no queued work.

completed-legacy-qa.intent: Gateway rescan resolves farm presets without duplicating or rewriting completed legacy QA.

pending-legacy-qa.intent: Gateway rescan preserves a legacy pending receipt id and its eligible contribution.

approved-pr-qa.intent: Explicit QA acceptance succeeds on an approved PR through fresh provider observation and durable intake.

bare-pr-migration.intent: Legacy live requests canonicalize bare PR numbers before entering the QA queue.

linked-source-qa.intent: Link QA to an owned completed review, preserve its exact head, deduplicate retries and reject foreign or stale sources through gateway endpoints.

automatic-source-qa.intent: Archive a completed source review through the gateway, preserve its opted-in QA follow-up across restarts, deduplicate receipts, reject disabled policy and avoid historical backfill.

publication-defaults.intent: Verify project publication opt-in survives unrelated review overrides, explicit opt-out wins, and values/origins persist across gateway restart without posting to GitHub.

publication-delivery-pass.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/pass pass
publication-delivery-pass.intent: Publish one pinned review with inline findings and retain a duplicate-safe receipt across archive, restart and explicit retry.

publication-delivery-stale.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/stale stale
publication-delivery-stale.intent: Reject a moved PR head through automatic and explicit publication with no provider mutation.

publication-delivery-revoked.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/revoked revoked
publication-delivery-revoked.intent: Reject withdrawn publication policy, then permit one explicit retry after policy is restored.

publication-delivery-lost-response.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/lost-response lost-response
publication-delivery-lost-response.intent: Recover a successful provider post after a lost response by its owned marker; never create a second review.

publication-accounts.intent: Retain each selected GitHub account and hold a shared review when publication accounts conflict, including after gateway restart.

publication-direct.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-direct temp/publication-proof/direct
publication-direct.intent: Create runs through the workspace CLI with publication inheritance, opt-out and explicit team selection; refuse forged authority and publish/retry the captured direct authority without launching workers.

publication-delivery-rejected.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/rejected rejected
publication-delivery-rejected.intent: An explicit HTTP 422 retains a retryable receipt; corrected provider acceptance publishes once and archived retries do not repost.

qa-pool.intent: Pool QA queues without pinning an arbitrary slot, preserves both allowed candidates across restart, and retains explicit user pins.

publication-delivery-concurrent.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/concurrent concurrent
publication-delivery-concurrent.intent: A concurrent publish RPC cannot replace the active durable receipt with a transient error; only one POST is sent.

publication-delivery-concurrent-tick.cmd: yarn exec tsx scripts/e2e-review-qa-contract.mts publication-delivery temp/publication-proof/concurrent-tick concurrent-tick
publication-delivery-concurrent-tick.intent: The real scheduled publication tick cannot write a durable error while a manual publication POST is in progress.
